name: peppermint/reminders
description: Reminder core for Laravel — a reminder on anything: a task, an appointment, whatever the application registers. Stores, queries and reports; delivery is bridged to peppermint/notifications when that package is present.

suggest.peppermint/notifications: For the delivery bridge: a due reminder becomes a notification, routed by the person's own per-channel preferences. Optional — Regel 7 des Paketvertrags: nicht erzwungen, damit das Paket fuer sich installierbar bleibt. Without it the package still stores, queries and reports; the product delivers.
